Choose the correct answer from the options given below: (1) A and C are true, but B and D are false (2) B and C are true, but A and D are false (3) A and D are true, but B and C are false (4) B and D are true, but A and C are false 100 75 75 100 125 25 500 200 400 300 700 500 MedicNEE Medi M EET MedicN dicNEET MedicNEE Medic T M cNEET
explanation:
Correct option: D.
